component.name: Strait Bible
component.summary: Read, compare and study the Bible

description.p: Strait Bible is a free, multilingual Bible reader. It is based on Unbound Bible by Vladimir Rybant.

ul.li: Many translations, commentaries, dictionaries and cross-references; compare translations side by side
Themes (light, dark, sepia and your own), your own fonts and background pictures
Bookmarks, highlights and your own notes on verses
Reading plans, verse of the day and a night theme
